title: Recently used files list
whyItMatters: Desktop applications record the documents, images and folders they opened, with paths and timestamps. It is a ready-made list of what the person worked on and when.
source: freedesktop.org Recent files spec: recent documents are listed in recently-used.xbel in the user data directory: https://specifications.freedesktop.org/recent-file-spec/latest/
notes: Written by GTK applications; each entry holds a file:// URI, a display name, timestamps and often the application that opened it. GNOME's privacy settings can keep the list from being written at all.
